clips.title: The story
paras: Dalson's Tears is a blighted farmstead located in the heart of the Western Plaguelands. Once known as Dalson's Orchard, the land was overrun during the Third War and converted into a staging ground for one of the Scourge's noxious plague cauldrons. The undead remains of the former owners still haunt the fields and outbuildings.

Before the Third War, this estate flourished as Dalson's Orchard, a productive farm in the breadbasket of Lordaeron. Today, the fields are choked with decay and rechristened Dalson's Tears. At the center of the ruined property stands a massive iron cauldron, constantly billowing virulent green plague vapors across the landscape. The device is overseen by Cauldron Lord Malvinious and defended by a pack of blighted zombies, rotting cadavers, and skeletal horrors serving the Lich King.
